records.finding: Package doc called flow/stage 'BOUNDED' stream labels, but ADR-0004's unregistered-fence is emitter-side and metrics-only; the outcome event keeps raw flow/stage, and this exporter has no registry to fence with. Only outcome is a structurally bounded enum, so an unregistered/dynamic flow becomes a distinct Loki stream — the cardinality risk the doc claimed to prevent.
records.evidence: // only the BOUNDED outcome dimensions become stream LABELS ; labels := {"flow": o.VC.Flow, "stage": o.Stage, "outcome": string(o.Result)}
records.reason: Cross-examiner confirmed (emitter.go flowStageLabels is metrics-only; ADR-0004 keeps raw names on events) and recommended doc-only. Rewrote the package doc and streamLabelKeys comment to state the truth: labels are flow/stage/outcome; outcome is enum-bounded; flow/stage are raw and their Loki cardinality follows the caller's registry discipline (an unregistered/dynamic flow mints a new stream); ADR-0004's cardinality guarantee is scoped to metrics, not this log adapter.
